derivation:
by
  exact Localization.flat (R := UnivBasisRing p) (VCPoly p) (Submonoid.powers (MvPolynomial.X 0 : VCPoly p))
explanation: VCRing p is definitionally this localization of VCPoly p. Localization.flat states that localizing a flat algebra remains flat over the base; polynomial-ring flatness is supplied by typeclass inference. The current proof instead applies localization flatness and transitivity separately.
